source:
# WMO document identifiers (pubid#763, widened): the WMO-No. publication
# series, the WMO-published S-100 product specifications, and the WMO
# technical-document series (WMO/TD, JCOMM Technical Report, GAW Report).
#
#   WMO-No. 1364                      publication, bare
#   WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition        publication, year edition (citation comma)
#   WMO-No. 1364 2025 edition         publication, year edition (cover stack)
#   WMO-No. 1364:ed2025               publication, compact year edition (alias)
#   WMO-No. 8, 2021/2018 edition      publication, compound year-pair edition
#                                     (primary year first, the IMOP wording)
#   WMO-No. 1364, 2023 edition,
#                 updated in 2025     publication, edition + updated-in year
#                                     (library record 69478)
#   WMO-No. 8, Provisional 2026
#                 edition             publication, status-qualified edition
#                                     (IMOP Knowledge-Hub)
#   WMO-No. 8, Volume I … V           volume face, roman (IMOP Guide page)
#   WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1           dotted-roman sub-volume (record 35713)
#   WMO-No. 9, Volume D               letter volume (Resolution 10 (SERCOM-1))
#   WMO/TD-No. 196                    the Technical Document series (the
#                                     library serial "WMO/TD-No."; the PREFIX
#                                     law of the widening ruling: the bare
#                                     "TD-No." head names no publisher, so it
#                                     never parses)
#   JCOMM Technical Report No. 14     the joint WMO/IOC series (self-
#                                     identifying head)
#   GAW Report No. 312                the GAW series, bare head (WMO's own
#                                     library records; the prefixed
#                                     "WMO/GAW Report No." spelling is
#                                     third-party citation only)
#   S-411                             S-100 product specification, bare
#   S-411 1.2.1                       dotted edition (the S-411 repo form)
#   S-411:ed1.2.1                     compact dotted edition (alias)
#   S-411 Annex A                     annex wrapper (the DCEG docidentifier)
#   S-411 Annex A 1.2.0               annex wrapper carrying its edition
#
# Editions are a type-driven face: the publication series carry calendar-
# year editions ("2025 edition", MRN `ed2025`); the S-100 shapes carry the
# IHO dotted x.y.z (MRN `ed1.2.1`). Both bind the one `edition_value`
# capture; the builder keys the face off the resolved type. The compound
# faces widen the same capture: the year pair ("2021/2018") is one
# edition value — the pair IS the identity face, the dotted-x.y.z rule of
# the S-100 side applied to years — and the status word ("Provisional")
# and the updated-in year ride their own captures beside it.
#
# The volume face precedes the edition face when both appear (the face
# order of the widening ruling; both faces individually attested on
# WMO-No. 306 Volume I.1 and the 2020-edition rows).
#
# Type assignment (the #763 ruling): the S-lexical form is a WMO type,
# publisher-parameterised per IALA's S-201 — the lexical shape is the IHO
# S-100 form, but the flavor owns the WMO-published documents
# (metanorma/S-411-Product-Specification, mn-document-class wmo).
#
# Edition-2 conversion with typed model bindings, mirroring the iala
# grammar: each alternative path carries at most one occurrence of every
# capture name, so the harvest delivers one flat bound map; the annex base
# composite stays unbound (its `doc_number` hoists to the top level) and
# the builder dispatches on `series_head` / `annex_marker`. The annex
# letter guard (!lower) keeps a following edition segment from
# mis-capturing.

grammar PubidWmo version "0.2.0" edition 2 {
  series_head = {
      "WMO-No." as series_head
    / "WMO/TD-No." as series_head
    / "JCOMM Technical Report No." as series_head
    / "GAW Report No." as series_head
  }
  doc_number = (1*digit) as doc_number
  s_code = "S-" (1*digit) as doc_number
  year_value = ((4digit) [slash (4digit)]) as edition_value
  dotted_value = (1*digit 1*(dot 1*digit)) as edition_value
  updated_tail = {
    "," space "updated" space "in" space ((4digit) as updated_in)
  }
  edition_year_human = {
    [","] space year_value " edition"
    [updated_tail]
  }
  edition_year_compact = (colon "ed" year_value) as edition
  edition_status_human = {
    [","] space ("Provisional" as edition_status) space year_value " edition"
  }
  edition_dotted_human = (space dotted_value) as edition
  edition_dotted_compact = (colon "ed" dotted_value) as edition
  volume_roman = {
      "VIII" / "VII" / "VI" / "III" / "II"
    / "IX" / "IV" / "X" / "V" / "I"
  }
  volume_value = ((volume_roman / upper) *(dot 1*digit)) as volume
  volume_face = { [","] space "Volume" space volume_value }
  annex_identifier = {
    s_code
    space
    ("Annex" / "ANNEX") as annex_marker
    [ (space upper as annex_letter !lower) ]
    [edition_dotted_human / edition_dotted_compact]
  }
  publication_identifier = {
    series_head space doc_number
    [volume_face]
    [edition_year_human / edition_status_human / edition_year_compact]
  }
  standard_identifier = {
    s_code
    [edition_dotted_human / edition_dotted_compact]
  }
  identifier = annex_identifier / publication_identifier / standard_identifier
  entry identifier: identifier

  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  space = " "

  bindings identifier {
    series_head -> series_head (string)
    doc_number -> doc_number (string)
    edition_value -> edition_value (string)
    volume -> volume (string)
    edition_status -> edition_status (string)
    updated_in -> updated_in (string)
    annex_marker -> annex_marker (string)
    annex_letter -> annex_letter (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "WMO-No. 1364"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364 2025 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364:ed2025"
    accept "S-411"
    accept "S-411 1.2.1"
    accept "S-411:ed1.2.1"
    accept "S-411 Annex A"
    accept "S-411 ANNEX A"
    accept "S-411 Annex A 1.2.0"
    # the widened publication faces
    accept "WMO-No. 306"
    accept "WMO-No. 8, Volume I"
    accept "WMO-No. 8, Volume V"
    accept "WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1"
    accept "WMO-No. 9, Volume D"
    accept "WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1, 2020 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 8, 2021/2018 edition"
    accept "WMO-No. 1364, 2023 edition, updated in 2025"
    accept "WMO-No. 8, Provisional 2026 edition"
    # the new series heads (the prefix law: every head names its publisher)
    accept "WMO/TD-No. 196"
    accept "JCOMM Technical Report No. 14"
    accept "GAW Report No. 312"
    reject "nonsense"
    reject "WMO-No. edition"
    reject "S-411 1234"
    # the prefix law rejects: a series head that names no publisher (the
    # bare TD-No. spellings), a misattributed publisher (no IMO TD series
    # exists — the wild string is an OCR misread), and the third-party
    # GAW citation form
    reject "TD-No. 1265"
    reject "TD No. 196"
    reject "IMO/TD-No. 259"
    reject "WMO/GAW Report No. 285"
    # the spaced cover variant of the TD head ("WMO/TD - No. 1469",
    # GAW-183 cover): deliberately outside the grammar — only the glued
    # library-serial head "WMO/TD-No." is defined
    reject "WMO/TD - No. 1469"
    example "WMO-No. 1364" { series_head: "WMO-No.", doc_number: "1364" }
    example "WMO-No. 1364, 2025 edition" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "1364",
      edition_value: "2025",
    }
    example "S-411 1.2.1" { doc_number: "411", edition_value: "1.2.1" }
    example "S-411 Annex A 1.2.0" {
      doc_number: "411",
      annex_marker: "Annex",
      annex_letter: "A",
      edition_value: "1.2.0",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 1364:ed2025" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "1364",
      edition_value: "2025",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "306",
      volume: "I.1",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 306, Volume I.1, 2020 edition" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "306",
      volume: "I.1",
      edition_value: "2020",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 8, 2021/2018 edition" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "8",
      edition_value: "2021/2018",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 1364, 2023 edition, updated in 2025" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "1364",
      edition_value: "2023",
      updated_in: "2025",
    }
    example "WMO-No. 8, Provisional 2026 edition" {
      series_head: "WMO-No.",
      doc_number: "8",
      edition_status: "Provisional",
      edition_value: "2026",
    }
    example "WMO/TD-No. 196" { series_head: "WMO/TD-No.", doc_number: "196" }
    example "JCOMM Technical Report No. 14" {
      series_head: "JCOMM Technical Report No.",
      doc_number: "14",
    }
    example "GAW Report No. 312" {
      series_head: "GAW Report No.",
      doc_number: "312",
    }
  }
}
